title: CV Tutorial chapters 16–20 — claim/source register
scope: Primary papers and official APIs; figures, pointer examples and runnable samples are illustrative, not benchmarks.

entries.claim: R-CNN replaces hand-crafted features with CNN features on bottom-up region proposals and reaches 53.3% mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012, a >30% relative gain over the previous best
entries.caveat: Figure taken from the paper abstract; VOC 2007 numbers and per-backbone comparisons live in the paper tables and are not restated here

entries.claim: Box regression targets are t_x=(G_x-P_x)/P_w, t_y=(G_y-P_y)/P_h, t_w=log(G_w/P_w), t_h=log(G_h/P_h) with Smooth L1 loss
entries.caveat: MathML states the four targets and the inverse decode; P_w,P_h>0 required

entries.claim: Selective Search oversegments, greedily merges regions by color/texture/size/shape and needs no training data
entries.caveat: The ~2000-box budget and recall percentage are paper-specific and not reproduced numerically here
